description: Free supplier-selection preview ("free sample"): returns the top-3 candidate suppliers APM would consider — names, unit prices, score breakdown, expected latency, historical success rate — plus the supplier that would be selected and the customer price. Executes nothing and charges nothing. This tool is free and never executes a purchase. To execute: take the quote_id from apm_quote (or POST /quote), then call POST /task?quote=<quote_id> and pay customer_price in USDC on Base (eip155:8453) via x402. Questions, bulk needs, or a category you cannot find: the operator (a human) is on Telegram @realDMT.

caller_id.description: Optional: your APM caller_id from apm_register — present it and APM recognizes you and remembers this ask (category + price only)

input.description: Token/wallet address, or search query text

max_budget.description: Max you will pay in USDC

name: apm_preview
